messages.subject: Re: Conditional formating in DT in Shiny
parts:
Please read the documentation ?DT::renderDataTable to see what exactly
its the arguments are.

1. The argument `options` belongs to datatable() instead of renderDataTable();
2. DT::renderDataTable() expects a table widget instead of a data
frame as its first argument.

http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html

Regards,
Yihui
